title: Y NOT?
summary: A streetwear storefront built around drops, colorways, and inventory that can't be oversold.
tagline: A storefront and commerce platform for an independent streetwear label, where every colorway has its own photography and stock is held for a shopper during checkout.
role: Developed the label's web brand system and designed and built the storefront and commerce platform.
problem: An independent clothing label needs a distinctive identity and a shopping experience that stays clear across product types, drops, and colorways, while its small inventory has to stay accurate when several people check out at once.
contribution: I applied the Y NOT? brand system to the web and designed and built the storefront and the commerce platform behind it, including the product photo workflow and an automated production setup.
solution: Shoppers browse by drop and colorway through collections, search, and filters. Product pages give each colorway its own photography and size selection per variant, and a slide-out cart with a free-shipping meter hands off to a secure checkout that supports cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Link.
solutionPoints: Home, collection, product, search, cart, checkout, about, contact, FAQ, and policy pages.
Wordmark lockups, oval mark, star motif, and a cream-and-ink palette applied across every page.
A photo workflow that turns raw shots into per-colorway galleries.
Pricing, payments, orders, and inventory handled by the store's own platform.

architecture.summary: Stock is held for the shopper during checkout and settled when payment completes.
flow: Order confirmed · stock committed or released

decisions.title: The store sets every price.
decisions.text: Prices, sale prices, and shipping thresholds are decided on the server, so a modified cart cannot change what someone pays.

decisions.title: No two shoppers get the last item.
decisions.text: Inventory is held during checkout and released automatically if the shopper doesn't finish.

decisions.title: Record every order exactly once.
decisions.text: Payment updates that arrive twice or out of order still produce a single, correct order.

outcomes: The storefront is live at ynot.lifestyle with the current catalog, colorway galleries, and a complete checkout path.
limits: ynot.lifestyle is the verified live address. A move to a newer domain has been discussed but is not confirmed, so this page links to the working site.
lessons: Brand presentation and dependable commerce behavior have to be designed together.
assistantNote: ynotbrand.co is a possible newer domain for Y NOT?. In an October 15, 2026 check it returned an error (HTTP 502), so the migration is not confirmed; the verified live store is https://ynot.lifestyle. Y NOT? is unrelated to wy_not_pics.
